name: Joan Quinn
milestones: Aunt Joan had a house in Ocean City, Maryland, where Barbara's family stayed on visits east when it was free.
sources: Barbara McKeldin Adams, "Barbara McKeldin Adams - A Memoir" (privately printed)
notes: Barbara identifies Joan as one of John Joseph Quinn’s children.
